lines.en: I give Maki a call and the two of us make plans to meet up at the cafe for breakfast.
lines.zh: 我给 Maki 打了个电话，约好早上在咖啡厅一起吃早餐。

lines.en: I guess she must consider it a special occasion or something as, when I get there, she’s not in her usual “casual pajama” look that she is somehow always okay with wearing out in public.
lines.zh: 我猜她大概把这当成什么特别的日子了，因为我到的时候，她没穿那身她向来毫不在意穿着出门的「居家睡衣」。

lines.en: But hey, maybe those days are gone forever as she turns over a new leaf and joins the world of working adults who wear normal clothes when they’re not at home.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也许那样的日子一去不返了——她洗心革面，加入了那群出门会穿正常衣服的成年上班族。

lines.en: I suppose that she and I may have different definitions of “working adults” though seeing as her line of work involves a much greater deal of semen than mine.
lines.zh: 我想我和她对「上班族」的定义可能不太一样，毕竟她那行当涉及的精液比我多得多。

lines.en: Either way, the two of us grab some coffee and take a seat in the back of the room to talk about sex or something away from the prying ears of Haruka as she is dramatically deprived of it.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我俩各拿了杯咖啡，在店最里面坐下，聊些关于性之类的话题——顺便躲开 Haruka 的耳朵，她可是极度缺乏这玩意儿。

lines.en: Upon sitting down, Maki becomes unusually sentimental and thanks me for both spending time with her and “taking care” of her daughter on a daily basis.
lines.zh: 一坐下，Maki 就异常感性地谢起我来，既谢我愿意陪她，也谢我每天都在「照顾」她女儿。

lines.en: I breathe a sigh of relief in knowing that she doesn’t quite understand exactly {i}how{/i} I am taking care of her daughter.
lines.zh: 知道她并不完全明白我是{i}怎么{/i}「照顾」她女儿的，我暗暗松了口气。

lines.en: But in terms of spending time with Maki, I don’t really understand why I need to be thanked at all. I’m the one who called her. It’s not as if someone is paying me to do this or anything.
lines.zh: 但说到陪 Maki 这件事，我真不明白有什么好谢的。是我打给她的。又没人付钱让我这么干。

lines.en: The fact of the matter is that when you look past the waterfall of euphemisms that creates the bulk of her personality, she really is just a normal girl who wants and tries to relate in her own sort of way.
lines.zh: 事实是，当你拨开构成她人格主体的那道委婉语瀑布，她真的只是个普通的女人，一个想用自己的方式与人相通、也一直在这么努力的人。

lines.en: The only problem is that she’s likely grown accustomed to {i}her{/i} way pushing others back. But I’m not one of those people.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，她大概已经习惯了用{i}自己{/i}的方式把别人推开。但我不是那种人。

lines.en: So I thank her in return for spending time with {i}me-{/i} another person who just can’t seem to relate.
lines.zh: 于是我也谢了她愿意陪{i}我{/i}——另一个怎么都学不会与人相通的人。
